verses.1: And Elohim said, “I will do it.”
verses.2: Indeed, I knew that this was true, and that it is just. A person should act in accordance with what is right.
verses.3: If he tries to fight with him, none of us will listen to him.
verses.4: A wise heart and great strength came to him from those difficulties he faced.
verses.5: The mountains have been moved, and they did not know that they had been turned into dust.
verses.6: The land will be devastated from its place, and its symbols will be destroyed.
verses.7: May it be hidden from sight, and may it not be seen by anyone. It will remain hidden among the stars.
verses.8: He walks alone across the skies, along the paths of the seas.
verses.9: He acts like a fool, like a magician, and like someone who knows nothing.
verses.10: He does great things beyond all measure, and his wonders are countless.
verses.11: It will pass over me, and I won’t see it. It will move away from me, and I won’t understand it either.
verses.12: Who will put them back in their place? Who will say to them, “What shall you do?”
verses.13: Elohim will not let him rest under His feet; his helpers will be destroyed.
verses.14: Even though I will answer him, I will choose my words carefully.
verses.15: If I have been justified, then I will not obey your judgment.
verses.16: If I call out to you, and you do not listen, then I do not believe that you will indeed hear my voice.
verses.17: Those who beat me with their fists, and my wounds are numerous.
verses.18: Do not let me sit down, O Lord, because those who slander me will bring me down.
verses.19: If I am strong enough, then who can accuse me? And if I am not strong enough, then who can condemn me?
verses.20: If my mouth speaks lies, then I will be condemned. But I will still persist in my truthfulness.
verses.21: I don’t know, my soul doesn’t like it at all.
verses.22: One reason I said “tam” is that the wicked are all equal in their nature.
verses.23: If Shot dies suddenly during a sacred ceremony, it will cause great sorrow.
verses.24: The land was given into the hands of the wicked. Their faces will be covered with shame, if they do not repent.
verses.25: And their days were shortened from me; they ran away, never seeing anything good.
verses.26: They passed by with those who were like slaves, who were forced to work under harsh conditions.
verses.27: If I forget my words, I will leave my face and abandon them.
verses.28: I have suffered all kinds of hardships; I knew that you would not cleanse me.
verses.29: I am evil; why do I suffer this suffering?
verses.30: If I were to wade through snowy waters, I would surely get wet all over.
verses.31: Then, in that moment, let it wash me away and carry me away with its waves.
verses.32: For no one can answer us together in the judgment.
verses.33: There shall be no one among us who touches our two hands.
verses.34: He takes away from me my throne, and his truth makes me suffer.
verses.35: I spoke, but I didn’t listen to them, because I wasn’t there at that time.
